misconceptions.description: Believing the ETHOBOT tutor assigns the official course grade or replaces the instructor
misconceptions.trigger: learner expects the tutor's response to be the final graded score
misconceptions.feedback: ETHOBOT is a practice and feedback tutor, not the grader. Your instructor and the rubric set the official grade; use the tutor to prepare.

misconceptions.description: Asking the tutor a vague question like 'help' or 'is this good' with no goal or context
misconceptions.trigger: learner sends a one-word or contextless request to the tutor
misconceptions.feedback: Give the tutor a goal, the artifact, and what you are stuck on, for example: 'Check whether this resume bullet has a measurable result.'

misconceptions.description: Asking the tutor to produce the finished assignment instead of feedback you can act on
misconceptions.trigger: learner asks the tutor to write or complete the deliverable
misconceptions.feedback: Ask for feedback, a comparison, or a next step you can apply. The work and the judgment stay yours.

misconceptions.description: Recording only accepted tutor suggestions in the critique log and dropping the rejected ones
misconceptions.trigger: learner logs only changes they made and not suggestions they declined
misconceptions.feedback: A complete critique log records accepted, modified, and rejected suggestions, each with a one-line reason.
